status.description: Status is the current status of the Template.

Template.title: Template
Template.description: Template is a reusable Workspace configuration inside a Space. Every Workspace is created from a Template and it inherits its spec. Every Space has a `default` Template that is automatically created along with it. A Template can additionally be associated with a GitProvider and it can be pre-built so that its Workspaces start from a ready-made storage snapshot.

image.description: Image defines how the container image of the Template's Workspaces is obtained.

runtime.description: Runtime controls the behavior of the container of the Template's Workspaces.

repository.description: Repository is the primary git repository which is cloned into the Template's Workspaces.

additionalRepositories.description: AdditionalRepositories is the list of the secondary repositories that are cloned alongside the primary one.

limit.description: Limit is the default compute resources that are allocated for the Template's Workspaces.

gitProvider.description: GitProvider is the name of a GitProvider in the same Space. Once it is set, the User's stored OAuth2 token is automatically injected into the Template's Workspaces which enables authenticated git operations without any manual credential configuration.

vars.description: Vars is the list of the variables that are substituted inside the spec.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.Sp.title: Spec
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.Sp.description: Spec is the Template specification. It shares most of the Workspace spec.

spaceRef.description: SpaceRef is the reference of the Space that owns the Template.

userRef.description: UserRef is the reference of the Octelium User who created the Template.

gitProviderRef.description: GitProviderRef is the reference of the GitProvider that is associated with the Template via the spec's gitProvider field.

buildInfo.description: BuildInfo is the state of the Template's pre-builds.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.St.title: Status
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.St.description: Status is the current status of the Template. It is managed by the Cluster and it is read-only.

builds.description: Builds is the history of the Template's pre-builds ordered from the most to the least recent one.

currentReadyBuildID.description: CurrentReadyBuildID is the ID of the pre-build whose storage snapshot the new Workspaces of the Template are currently restored from.

currentRunningBuildID.description: CurrentRunningBuildID is the ID of the pre-build that is currently running, if any.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.St.title: Build Info
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.St.description: BuildInfo is the state of the Template's pre-builds.

id.description: ID is a randomly generated identifier of the pre-build.

tags.description: Tags is the list of the tags that the pre-build was started with. It defaults to `latest`.

startedAt.description: StartedAt is the timestamp at which the pre-build started.

doneAt.description: DoneAt is the timestamp at which the pre-build completed, failed or was canceled.

isCanceled.description: IsCanceled means that the pre-build was explicitly canceled (e.g. via the CancelBuildTemplate method or by starting a new pre-build).

failure.description: Failure is the reason of the failure of the pre-build, if any.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the pre-build

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.St.title: Build
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Template.St.description: Build is a single pre-build of the Template.

name.description: Name is the name of the additional repository. It must be unique within the spec.

clonePath.description: ClonePath is the absolute path inside the Workspace where the repository is cloned (e.g. `/workspace/additional-repos/shared-libs`).

repository.description: Repository is the repository's URL, clone options and authentication.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Additional Repository
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: AdditionalRepository is a secondary repository that is cloned alongside the Workspace's primary repository.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile builds the image from an inline or a downloaded Dockerfile.

registry.description: Registry pulls a pre-built image from a container registry.

git.description: Git builds the image from a dedicated git repository.

repository.description: Repository builds the image from the Workspace's own primary repository.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Image
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Image defines how the container image that is used as the Workspace's root filesystem is obtained. If it is unset, the Cluster's default base image is used.

inline.description: Inline is the content of the Dockerfile provided as a string.

url.description: URL is a URL from which the Dockerfile content is downloaded.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Dockerfile
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Dockerfile builds the image from a Dockerfile that is provided directly instead of being read from a repository.

url.description: URL is the HTTPS URL of the git repository (e.g. `https://github.com/myorg/dev-images`).

checkout.description: Checkout is an optional branch, tag or commit to check out after cloning the repository.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile is the path of the Dockerfile inside the repository. If it is unset, Cordium looks for a devcontainer spec (i.e. `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` or `.devcontainer.json`) in the repository instead.

context.description: Context is the build context directory inside the repository. It defaults to the repository root.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Git
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Git builds the image from a dedicated git repository which is separate from the Workspace's own repository.

url.description: URL is the image reference (e.g. `ubuntu:24.04` or `registry.example.com/dev/base:latest`).

authentication.description: Authentication is set for the private registries that require authentication.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Registry
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Registry pulls a pre-built image from a container registry.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Authentication
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Authentication is the credentials that are used to pull the image from a private registry.

fromSecret.description: FromSecret is the name of a Secret in the same Space whose content is used as the password. It is resolved by the Cluster at initialization time.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Password
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Password is the registry password or token.

devcontainer.description: Devcontainer builds the image from the repository's devcontainer spec.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile builds the image from a Dockerfile inside the repository.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Repository
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Repository builds the image out of the Workspace's own primary repository (i.e. the `repository` field of the spec).

dirPath.description: DirPath is the directory of the devcontainer spec inside the repository (e.g. `.devcontainer`).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Devcontainer
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Devcontainer builds the image from the Development Container spec that is contained in the repository.

path.description: Path is the path of the Dockerfile inside the repository (e.g. `docker/Dockerfile.dev`).

context.description: Context is the build context directory inside the repository. It defaults to the repository root.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Dockerfile
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Dockerfile builds the image from a Dockerfile that is contained in the repository.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Limit
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Limit is the compute resources that are allocated for the Workspace. The effective limits are resolved by precedence (i.e. Workspace, Template, Space default and then the Cluster default) and are then capped by the Space and the Cluster maximums.

millicores.description: Millicores is the number of CPU millicores (i.e. 1 core equals 1000 millicores).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: CPU
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: CPU is the CPU allocation.

megabytes.description: Megabytes is the amount of memory in megabytes.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Memory
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Memory is the memory allocation.

megabytes.description: Megabytes is the amount of disk storage in megabytes.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Storage is the storage allocation.

url.description: URL is the HTTPS URL of the git repository (e.g. `https://github.com/myorg/my-project`). Only the `https` scheme is supported.

cloneOptions.description: CloneOptions controls how the repository is cloned.

authentication.description: Authentication is set for the private repositories that require authentication.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Repository
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Repository is a git repository that is cloned into the Workspace at initialization time.

http.description: HTTP is the HTTP basic authentication.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Authentication
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Authentication is the credentials that are used to clone private repositories. It is not needed when a GitProvider is associated with the Template since, in that case, the User's OAuth2 token is automatically injected instead.

username.description: Username is the basic authentication username (e.g. `oauth2`).

password.description: Password is the basic authentication password.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: HTTP
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: HTTP is the HTTP basic authentication credentials.

fromSecret.description: FromSecret is the name of a Secret in the same Space whose content is used as the password. It is resolved by the Cluster at initialization time.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Password
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Password is the password, token or personal access token.

branch.description: Branch is the branch to be cloned. It defaults to the repository's default branch.

depth.description: Depth is the number of commits to be fetched. It is only effective when disableLazyUnshallow is set.

singleBranch.description: SingleBranch fetches only the chosen branch instead of every branch.

shallowSubmodules.description: ShallowSubmodules clones the repository's submodules with a depth of 1.

checkout.description: Checkout is an optional commit or tag to check out after cloning.

disableLazyUnshallow.description: DisableLazyUnshallow disables Cordium's default behavior of performing a shallow clone for a faster startup and then fetching the full history asynchronously in the background.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Clone Options
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: CloneOptions controls how the repository is cloned.

envVars.description: EnvVars is the list of the environment variables that are injected into the Workspace container.

tasks.description: Tasks is the list of the lifecycle tasks of the Workspace.

disableInit.description: DisableInit disables the minimal init process that Cordium runs as PID 1 in order to reap the zombie processes. It should only be set when the image already contains its own init system.

cmd.description: Cmd overrides the container image's default command.

entrypoint.description: Entrypoint overrides the container image's default entrypoint.

devcontainers.description: Devcontainers is the Development Container-related configuration.

octelium.description: Octelium controls the Octelium Services that are served inside the Workspace.

network.description: Network is the network-related configuration of the Workspace.

filesystem.description: Filesystem is the container filesystem configuration.

capabilities.description: Capabilities is the Linux capabilities of the Workspace's container.

timeout.description: Timeout controls the inactivity timeout of the Workspace.

autoStop.description: AutoStop automatically stops the Workspace once all of its non-background lifecycle tasks complete. It is mostly useful for CI/CD and automated workloads where no human interaction is expected.

volumeMounts.description: VolumeMounts is the list of the Volumes of the Workspace's Space that are mounted inside the Workspace. The mounts that are defined by the Template are merged with the ones that are defined by the Workspace itself.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Runtime
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Runtime controls the behavior of the Workspace's container (i.e. its environment variables, lifecycle tasks, capabilities, timeout, etc...).

add.description: Add is the list of the Linux capabilities that are added (e.g. `NET_ADMIN`).

drop.description: Drop is the list of the Linux capabilities that are dropped (e.g. `NET_RAW`).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Capabilities
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Capabilities is the Linux capabilities of the Workspace's container. It is merged with the Space-level and the ClusterConfig-level capabilities.

features.description: Features is the list of the Development Container Features that are installed inside the Workspace. They are merged with the Features that are declared by the repository's own devcontainer spec, if any.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Devcontainers
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Devcontainers is the Development Container-related configuration.

reference.description: Reference is the OCI reference of the Feature (e.g. `ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/docker-in-docker:2`).

options.description: Options is the list of the Feature's installation options.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Feature
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Feature is a Development Container Feature that is installed inside the Workspace.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Option
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Option is a Feature-specific installation option.

key.description: Key is the environment variable's name.

value.description: Value is the value provided directly as a string.

fromSecret.description: FromSecret is the name of a Secret in the same Space whose content is used as the value. It is resolved by the Cluster at initialization time.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Env Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: EnvVar is an environment variable that is injected into the Workspace container as well as into all of its lifecycle tasks.

readOnly.description: ReadOnly makes the container's root filesystem read-only.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Filesystem
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Filesystem is the container filesystem configuration.

egress.description: Egress is the egress (i.e. outbound) traffic configuration.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Network
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Network is the network-related configuration of the Workspace.

rules.description: Rules is the list of the egress rules.

defaultAction.title: Default Action
defaultAction.description: DefaultAction is the action that is applied when no Rule matches

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Egress
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Egress is the egress (i.e. outbound) traffic configuration of the Workspace. The Rules are unordered. A destination that is matched by a DENY Rule is denied even if it is also matched by an ALLOW Rule. A destination that is matched by no Rule falls back to the DefaultAction. The Cluster's own protected networks are always denied regardless of the configuration.

cidrs.description: CIDRs is the list of the network ranges, in CIDR notation, that are matched by the Rule. At least one CIDR must be set.

action.title: Action
action.description: Action is the effect of the Rule when it matches

ports.description: Ports is the list of the destination ports that are matched by the Rule. An empty list matches every port.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Rule is a network rule that matches a set of network ranges and ports.

serveServices.description: ServeServices is the list of the names of the Octelium Services, among the ones assigned to the owner User, that are served inside the Workspace.

serveAll.description: ServeAll serves every Octelium Service that is assigned to the owner User inside the Workspace.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Octelium
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Octelium controls the `octelium connect` process that runs inside the Workspace using the Workspace's own dedicated Octelium Session. It is what enables secretless access from inside the Workspace to the Octelium Services that its owner User is authorized to access.

name.description: Name is a unique name for the Task. It is used in the logs and in the failure reporting.

run.description: Run is the shell command that is executed by the Task.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the point of the Workspace's lifecycle at which the Task is run

envVars.description: EnvVars is the list of per-task environment variables.

workingDir.description: WorkingDir is the working directory of the Task. It defaults to the Workspace User's home directory.

isBackground.description: IsBackground starts the Task and lets the Workspace's initialization proceed without waiting for the Task to complete.

onFailure.title: On Failure
onFailure.description: OnFailure is the behavior of the Cluster when the Task fails

runAsRoot.description: RunAsRoot runs the Task as `root` instead of as the Workspace User.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Task
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Task is a command that is run at a defined point of the Workspace's lifecycle.

key.description: Key is the environment variable's name.

value.description: Value is the environment variable's value.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Env Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: EnvVar is a per-task environment variable which is merged with the Workspace-level environment variables.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Mode is the inactivity timeout mode

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Timeout
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Timeout controls the inactivity timeout after which a running Workspace is automatically stopped by the Cluster.

volumeRef.description: VolumeRef is the reference of the mounted Volume. The Volume must belong to the same Space as the Workspace.

mountPath.description: MountPath is the absolute, canonical path inside the Workspace's container at which the Volume is mounted (e.g. `/data`). It cannot be the root directory, it cannot overlap with another mount and it cannot cover the paths that are reserved by the Cluster.

readOnly.description: ReadOnly mounts the Volume read-only inside this Workspace. It is set per mount (i.e. the same Volume can simultaneously be mounted read-write by a Workspace and read-only by another one).

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Volume Mount
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: VolumeMount attaches a Volume of the Workspace's Space to a path inside the Workspace's container.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Var is a variable that can be referenced from within the spec's string fields using the `${{ vars.NAME }}` syntax. The substitution is performed after all the configuration levels are merged.

message.description: Message is a human-readable description of the failure.

imageBuild.description: ImageBuild means that building the container image failed.

imagePull.description: ImagePull means that pulling the container image failed.

repoClone.description: RepoClone means that cloning the primary repository failed.

buildTimeoutExceeded.description: BuildTimeoutExceeded means that the image build did not complete within the allowed duration.

task.description: Task means that a lifecycle task failed.

startupUnknown.description: StartupUnknown means that the Workspace failed to start for an undetermined reason.

startupTimeoutExceeded.description: StartupTimeoutExceeded means that the Workspace did not become ready within the allowed duration.

loadStorage.description: LoadStorage means that loading the persistent storage failed.

saveStorage.description: SaveStorage means that saving the persistent storage failed.

stoppageTimeoutExceeded.description: StoppageTimeoutExceeded means that the Workspace did not stop gracefully within the allowed duration.

runContainer.description: RunContainer means that running the Workspace's container failed.

healthCheck.description: HealthCheck means that the Workspace failed its health checks.

unknown.description: Unknown means that the run failed for an unclassified reason.

additionalRepoClone.description: AdditionalRepoClone means that cloning one of the additional repositories failed.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy means that the Workspace's network configuration could not be enforced.

volume.description: Volume means that one of the mounted Volumes could not be resolved.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Failure
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Failure describes the reason of the failure of a Workspace run.

name.description: Name is the name of the additional repository that failed to be cloned.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Additional Repo Clone
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: AdditionalRepoClone means that cloning one of the additional repositories failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Build Timeout Exceeded
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: BuildTimeoutExceeded means that the image build did not complete within the allowed duration.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Health Check
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: HealthCheck means that the Workspace failed its health checks.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Image Build
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: ImageBuild means that building the container image failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Image Pull
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: ImagePull means that pulling the container image failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Load Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: LoadStorage means that loading the Workspace's persistent storage failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Network Policy
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: NetworkPolicy means that the Workspace's network configuration could not be enforced. The Workspace is not started in that case.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Repo Clone
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: RepoClone means that cloning the primary repository failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Run Container
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: RunContainer means that running the Workspace's container failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Save Storage
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: SaveStorage means that saving the Workspace's persistent storage failed.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Startup Timeout Exceeded
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: StartupTimeoutExceeded means that the Workspace did not become ready within the allowed duration.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Startup Unknown
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: StartupUnknown means that the Workspace failed to start for an undetermined reason.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Stoppage Timeout Exceeded
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: StoppageTimeoutExceeded means that the Workspace did not stop gracefully within the allowed duration.

name.description: Name is the name of the failed Task.

exitCode.description: ExitCode is the exit code with which the Task's command exited.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Task
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Task means that a lifecycle task failed while its onFailure was set to abort the initialization.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Unknown
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Unknown means that the run failed for an unclassified reason.

name.description: Name is the name of the Volume that could not be resolved.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Volume
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Volume means that one of the Volumes that are mounted by the Workspace could not be resolved (e.g. it does not exist anymore, it belongs to another Space or it is hosted in another Region). The Workspace is not started in that case.

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
